title: The barcode shaped like a Go board

probes.question: Which board game influenced the black-and-white design of the QR code?
What did the QR code first label?

image.alt: Illustration of a Go board with black and white stones forming the three square corner markers of a QR code

panels.text: QR is short for quick-response. A QR code is a type of two-dimensional matrix barcode invented in 1994 by Masahiro Hara of the Japanese company Denso Wave for labelling automobile parts.
The alternating-square design was influenced by the black and white stones played on a Go board.
The pattern of the position detection markers was determined by finding the least-used sequence of alternating black-white areas on printed matter, which was 1:1:3:1:1.
